name: atlas-ledger-intents-v1
label_rules: Each ledger entry takes exactly one intent label: chargeback when a card dispute is opened, refund when a merchant-initiated return posts, fee_adjustment when a platform fee is corrected, payout when funds move to the operator's account.

state.entry: Stripe dispute opened on ch_3Px9 — cardholder claims unrecognized charge

items.label: chargeback
items.label_rule: a card dispute opened by the issuer is a chargeback

state.entry: merchant-initiated return of ord_88 posted to customer balance

items.label: refund
items.label_rule: a merchant-initiated return is a refund

state.entry: platform fee on inv_201 reduced from 3.9% to 2.9% after contract renewal

items.label: fee_adjustment
items.label_rule: a platform fee correction is a fee adjustment

state.entry: weekly settlement transferred to operating account ending 4471

items.label: payout
items.label_rule: funds moving to the operator account are a payout

state.entry: issuer dispute on ch_7Qm2 escalated to pre-arbitration

items.label: chargeback
items.label_rule: an issuer dispute at any stage is a chargeback

state.entry: partial return on ord_104 issued for damaged item

items.label: refund
items.label_rule: a partial merchant return is a refund

state.entry: annual volume rebate applied against accrued platform fees

items.label: fee_adjustment
items.label_rule: a fee credit or rebate is a fee adjustment

state.entry: instant payout requested to debit card ending 9902

items.label: payout
items.label_rule: an instant transfer out is a payout

state.entry: dispute network fee assessed on won chargeback ch_1Aa

items.label: fee_adjustment
items.label_rule: a fee assessed by the network is a fee adjustment, not the dispute itself

state.entry: return authorization for ord_77 converted to refund on receipt

items.label: refund
items.label_rule: a completed return is a refund

state.entry: chargeback ch_9Zz filed with reason code 10.4 fraud

items.label: chargeback
items.label_rule: a filed dispute is a chargeback

state.entry: reserve release transferred to operating account

items.label: payout
items.label_rule: a reserve release to the operator is a payout

state.entry: Visa dispute on ch_4Bx opened, reason 13.1 merchandise not received

items.label: chargeback
items.label_rule: an opened dispute is a chargeback

state.entry: customer credited after duplicate billing on inv_330

items.label: refund
items.label_rule: a credit for a billing error is a refund

state.entry: currency conversion markup waived on settlement

items.label: fee_adjustment
items.label_rule: a waived fee is a fee adjustment

state.entry: monthly payout to platform operating account executed

items.label: payout
items.label_rule: a scheduled transfer out is a payout

state.entry: second dispute opened on previously refunded ord_51

items.label: chargeback
items.label_rule: a dispute on a refunded order is still a chargeback

state.entry: goodwill credit applied after service outage

items.label: refund
items.label_rule: a goodwill credit is a refund

state.entry: Amex dispute on ch_2Kk, reason C02 credit not processed

items.label: chargeback
items.label_rule: a credit-not-processed dispute is a chargeback

state.entry: full return on ord_140 for unfulfilled preorder

items.label: refund
items.label_rule: a return for unfulfilled goods is a refund

state.entry: interchange-plus pricing trued up for Q3 volume

items.label: fee_adjustment
items.label_rule: a pricing true-up is a fee adjustment

state.entry: manual payout cut to settle negative balance

items.label: payout
items.label_rule: a manual settlement transfer is a payout
